title: Gitmap color record (one line of colors.ndjson)
description: One palette colour. colors.ndjson line order is the stacking order: the first line is the topmost colour. No stacking index is stored.

id.description: Stable id: color_<slug(name)> (color_unnamed when the slug is empty). Colours sharing a slug are ranked by stacking position (topmost first) then order; all but the first take _2, _3, …. Symbols reference this, never a number.

order.description: Source palette number (OCAD colour number; Mapper priority), kept for round-trips. Not part of the id and not the stacking order.

rgb.description: Screen colour as an [r, g, b] integer triple (0..255), matching cmyk's array shape.

cmyk.description: Print/OCAD ink [c,m,y,k], each 0..1, snapped to OCAD's whole-percent (2 dp) grid.
